ini.Notes: Datasheet covers SigenStor BAT 6.0 and 10.0 plus the SigenStor BC controller. BC operating voltage range is 300 to 600 V for single phase and 600 to 900 V for three phase, weight 8 kg, dimensions 765 / 109 / 260 mm without decorative cover, communication CAN.

Multi-model brochure covering 4 optimizers in two series. T1 covers AMCP500-600T1 and AMCP600-750T1, T2 covers AMCP1000-1200 and AMCP1200-1500. Rated power of this model is 1500 W and maximum input power is 1800 W. Maximum voltage in the disconnected state is 1 V and maximum system voltage is 1500 V. PV optimizer overvoltage level II. Relative humidity range 0 to 100 percent, highest altitude 4000 m. Input cable length is 1.4 m positive and negative, customizable. Output cable length is 0.3 m positive, 2.7 m negative, customizable. User interface is WEB and APP through AndCloud. One ADCU data collection unit supports up to 30 strings. Above 70 degC the device may work in derating mode and returns to normal after the temperature decreases.
ini.Mounting_Type: Rotatable mounting with bolts and clip on the module frame or rail
